description: nhflow_2d_beach_suspended_mpi2 with the semi-implicit momentum (A 510 12), 1200 steps: columns flagged wet with a water depth of zero or below the film A 544 are dry for the suspended load (nhflow_suspended_IM1::wet_columns, nhflow_scalar_ifou::wet_mask). Before, a wet column of zero depth gave inf and NaN coefficients, bicgstab returned the old concentration of the whole domain and the bed took the exchange of the step anyway.
covers: sediment with nhflow_momentum_SI and wetting and drying
